'Si ese archivo no llega, la fumigacion sigue
abierta.' Without verification record, case stays
in verifying and A21 alarms fire.

div.div:
Amazon S3 Drone Object Bucket Hierarchy (Workload Account pdn | us-east-1 | SSE-KMS Key 'objects' | Block Public Access | 5-Year Lifecycle Retention ASM-145):
• Pest Case Missions: farms/{farm_id}/cases/{case_id}/{mission_type}/{mission_id}/ (types: confirmation, fumigation, verification)
• Mission Sub-Prefixes: package/mission-package-v{n}.json (issued package) | record/flight-record.json (returned record) | photos/{seq}.jpg | track/{seq}.json | maps/ | polygons/
• Review Campaign Missions: farms/{farm_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}/{mission_type}/{mission_id}/ (types: delimitation, estimation) | Extra Delimitation: farms/{farm_id}/extra/{mission_id}/delimitation/
• Quarantine Prefix: quarantine/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{original_key} (unmatched grants, revoked pilot/kit, or person screen quarantine; never linked to order or inference, PD-104)
